四级核心词汇 · 04英文原文

The Last Tray Before Midnight

午夜前送出的最后一盘饭 · 595 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A hotel had prepared a banquet for a visiting orchestra. When the concert was canceled, dozens of portions of pork, peas, and ripe melon remained. Suri, the chef, suggested supper for the night workers at a nearby hospital. A manager wanted to dump the excess food and avoid any liability. Suri thought some of it was still suitable. She asked for a proper inspection before they made a decision.

2She checked the freezer first. A faulty seal had let heat enter. Some trays were solid. Others had begun to thaw. Suri noted the temperature of each batch and discarded the meat from the unreliable shelf. She put the fruit in a separate fridge. Bacteria could multiply without changing the scent, and a dirty utensil could contaminate food. The staff separated raw meat from everything they could already serve.

3Ham was scarce, but vegetables were plentiful. Suri chopped the meat and let it boil in a pot. She cut the soft flesh of a mushroom into thick slices to supplement the pork. A cook stirred a spoon of cream into a small pan on medium heat. He liked the blend. Suri kept a plain portion as well. A patient might chew soft food yet struggle to digest a dense stew.

4The staff chilled the fruit, then packed it with cheese and nuts in separate packets. Suri weighed each portion in ounces and marked the contents. A helper wanted to omit the labels. Suri handed him two identical cartons and asked him to tell her which contained nuts. He fetched a pencil. That small demonstration made the need for clear labels obvious. They could use a substitute ingredient, provided someone recorded the change.

5The delivery crew normally catered for grand occasions. Its brochure advertised champagne, wine, and steak. Tonight the crew loaded a beverage for every worker. A driver almost put brandy in the juice crate. The caps looked identical from above. Water began to condense on the cold bottles. It made the sticky labels peel. The driver tossed them out and marked the alcohol crate with bright tape. Otherwise someone might pick it up by mistake. The catering chain could rely on colored ties for drinks, provided it used one color code. Suri sent him to the service entrance opposite the reception hall.

6A nurse met the truck and led the crew to the counter. The meal smelled pleasant, but a tray was upside down. The lid had opened. Two workers in the ward could barely leave their posts. The nurse divided the remaining servings and sent the porter upstairs. Suri arranged an immediate replacement. The farthest ward would be their priority the following night. Any delay would be apparent sooner.

7The nurse gave Suri some useful feedback. A few workers had little appetite after a long shift, and others wanted a dish that could nourish them without being too rich. Suri tested a lighter stew with corn. A thick paste held the spare portions together in the oven. She made a smaller batch so none would spoil while the delivery staff completed their route.

8The orchestra's next arrival was a week later. The manager asked how to prepare for another cancellation. Suri put the hospital's number on the order sheet and kept a smaller reserve of meat. He offered her a bonus for the extra effort. She asked him to fix the seal first. Before the first guest arrived, he came to the kitchen and checked that the door closed tight. Suri had made sure they could act on the plan before they needed it.

四级核心词汇 · 04中文译文

午夜前送出的最后一盘饭

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一家酒店为来访的管弦乐团准备了宴会。音乐会取消后，厨房还剩几十份猪肉、豌豆和熟甜瓜。厨师苏丽提议给附近医院的夜班人员送一顿饭。一位经理怕担责任，想把多出来的食材倒掉。苏丽觉得有些还能用，请大家先仔细检查再决定。

2她先查冷冻柜。密封条坏了，热气漏进去。有些托盘还冻得很硬，有些已经开始化了。苏丽记下每一批食材的温度，把温度不稳的那层架子上的肉丢掉，水果另放一台冰箱。细菌繁殖时，食物的气味可能没有变化，脏餐具也可能污染食物。工作人员把生肉和已经可以供应的食物分开。

3火腿不多，蔬菜却很充足。苏丽把肉切碎，放进锅里煮。她把软嫩的蘑菇切成厚片，用来补充猪肉。一名厨师在小锅里用中火搅入一勺奶油，很喜欢这个搭配。苏丽也留了一份清淡的。有的病人能嚼软食，太浓稠的炖菜却可能消化不了。

4工作人员把水果冷藏后，连同奶酪和坚果分开装袋。苏丽用盎司称好每一份，再标出里面装了什么。一名助手想省掉标签。苏丽递给他两个一模一样的盒子，请他说出哪盒有坚果。他转身拿来一支铅笔。小小的演示让清楚的标签有什么用变得一目了然。换食材也可以，只要有人把变动记下来。

5配送团队平常承接的是隆重场合，宣传册上印着香槟、葡萄酒和牛排。今晚，他们给每位夜班人员都装了一份饮料。一名司机差点把白兰地放进果汁箱，瓶盖从上面看一模一样。冷瓶上开始凝结水珠，黏标签也翘了起来。司机把脱落的标签扔掉，用鲜艳的胶带标出装酒的箱子，免得有人拿错。餐饮连锁可以用彩色扎带辨认饮料，前提是大家采用同一套颜色。苏丽让他从接待大厅对面的后勤入口进去。

6一位护士到货车旁接人，带他们去了柜台。饭菜闻起来很香，却有一盘放倒了，盖子也开了。那个病区有两位工作人员几乎抽不开身。护士把剩下的饭分了分，请勤杂人员先送上楼。苏丽马上安排补送一份。第二晚，他们决定优先卸下最远病区的餐盒，这样延误也能早点发现。

7护士给了苏丽一些有用的反馈。有的人上完长班没什么胃口，也有人想吃有营养又不太油腻的饭。苏丽试做了加玉米的清淡炖菜，用稠糊把几份剩下的料拌匀，放进烤箱。她少做了一些，好让食物在配送结束前保持新鲜。

8乐团一周后再次到店。经理问，再碰到演出取消，该怎么准备。苏丽在订餐单上写了医院的号码，也少留了一些备用肉。经理要给她一笔额外奖金，她请他先修好密封条。第一位客人来之前，经理到厨房检查柜门能不能关严。这样等下次真遇到变化时，大家就能按计划办。
